paragraphs: At Harbourline Group I led a purchase-to-pay automation programme across six countries that cut invoice processing time from nine days to four. Northwind's plan to automate P2P and R2R with an AI-assisted platform is the next step from the work I have been doing, and I would like to help build it as your Senior Product Owner.

I bring the finance side of the problem in depth. I have documented AP and general ledger processes end to end, tested them through an SAP S/4HANA migration, and run the workshops where finance users explain what actually slows them down. I am used to turning that into priorities a delivery team can act on, and into business cases that finance leadership will fund.

I have not yet held a Product Owner title, and I want to be direct about that. The work has been close to it: owning requirements for our invoice automation tool, deciding what shipped first, and tracking adoption through the Power BI dashboards I built for our CFO. I am keen to formalise this in an Agile team, and I would bring the user's perspective that finance automation products often lack.
I would welcome the chance to discuss how I could help Northwind raise its straight-through processing rate. Thank you for your time.

questions.question: You have not held a Product Owner title. Why should we hire you for this role?
questions.approach: Acknowledge it, then show the product work you have done: owning requirements, prioritising, measuring adoption. Point to your finance-domain depth as the harder part to hire for.

questions.question: How would you prioritise a backlog when Finance and Engineering disagree?
questions.approach: Describe a framework (value vs effort, or KPI impact) and use an example from the ERP workshops.

questions.question: Which KPIs would you use to measure success for P2P automation?
questions.approach: Straight-through processing rate, cost per invoice, cycle time, exception rate, user adoption. Link them to your 9-to-4-day result.

questions.question: Tell me about a time you had to influence a senior stakeholder.
questions.approach: Use the CFO dashboard story: what decision the data enabled.

questions.question: What excites you about AI in finance operations?
questions.approach: Be specific: invoice data extraction, exception handling, and why finance users will trust it only if the product earns it.

questions_to_ask: What is the current straight-through processing rate, and where do you want it in a year?
